cues.text: Off a frontage road in Round Rock, in a building
that took phone orders, sits Horizon. Half is
running. The rest comes this winter. The operator's own guide says access is limited
to internal users. The queue table under it is finished, priced by
the node hour. West of there, the private campus
at Abilene has an estimated fifty thousand accelerators in one building. Nobody
outside publishes that. Somebody spent three years porting
code for a door that says no. What makes it public
was never its size. The city measured the water and put it on a page. The only machine in Texas you can check is the small one.
